scope: Every available run 1 through 59 from the current GitHub workflow inventory; every failed and cancelled run has complete job metadata and a failure/cancellation review. Successful runs supply inventory and closure, not fresh full-log re-audits.
boundaries: Deleted runs or unavailable older workflow identities cannot be reconstructed from this inventory.
Separate Security/Compatibility workflows and local-only failures are not counted as Reviewed checks failures.
Runs, failed jobs and distinct causes are different counts; duplicate push/PR runs and downstream coverage refusals are retained without multiplying product bugs.
All observed run_attempt values are 1; later new candidate runs are not retries of the same run.
No historical tests were replayed; original assertions, retained repair records and later actual results have distinct evidence scopes.
